content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to [product_name]. I'd like to log analog input data to an SD card and also connect it to AI. Can anyone assist me with this? Kind regards, [user_name]

Welcome to the forum. I've attached an example for you. Data logging on [product_name] creates a new entry only when a low-to-high edge is detected at the enable input. If you keep this input permanently high, only one entry will be made. In the provided example, a log entry is generated every five minutes. When an SD card is inserted, data logs are saved automatically. The log file on the SD card can hold up to 20,000 entries for this specific [article_no]. If the log file reaches its limit and there is more space on the card, a new file will be created. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to log analog input data and save it to an SD card using [product_name]. Replies explained how data logging works, the importance of the enable input for triggering entries, intervals for data log creation, SD card handling, and file size limitations. Details were given to help new users understand these specific behaviors.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking a simple and efficient way to record analog input data to an SD card using [product_name], preferring either a continuous method or one that is easy to trigger and manage.
